About this page and your data

What this is. A private screening tool for one mailbox. Every number in a row is either copied from a listing email (the row details show the exact wording) or calculated by plain code from those numbers and the fixed assumptions above. Nothing here is advice or a valuation, and no row is scored or ranked: it is a first screen, to be checked against the listing itself.

Neighborhood grades and rent estimates are arithmetic over public data (US Census ACS, HUD Fair Market Rents, FEMA flood and risk data, OpenStreetMap). They describe a census tract or ZIP code, not this building, and they are not a judgement about the people who live there. Do not use them to decide whom to rent to.

This page sets no cookies and loads nothing from anywhere. It is one self-contained file with no analytics, no tracking and no third-party scripts. The only thing it stores is your saved filter sets, in this browser's local storage, on this device, only when you press "Save filter as…"; "Delete saved set" removes them. The links in the rows open the sender's listing pages, which have their own policies.

Where the data came from and how long it is kept is written up in PRIVACY.md in the repository (listing emails, the sender's name and address, the text sent to the AI reader, retention periods, and how to delete).
